name: cerca-en-maps-firefox
description: Extension privada de Firefox para buscar categorias cerca de una ubicacion en Google Maps.

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files package-lock.json package.json README.md PRIVACY.md tests/**
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir ../cerca-en-maps-artifacts --overwrite-dest --ignore-files package-lock.json package.json README.md PRIVACY.md tests/**
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --source-dir . --artifacts-dir ../cerca-en-maps-artifacts --channel=unlisted --ignore-files package-lock.json package.json README.md PRIVACY.md tests/**
